verdict.rationale: Fireflies offers AskFred, an AI assistant that answers natural language questions over meeting transcripts, plus automatic AI-generated summaries, action items, and analytics inside the product, and an MCP server that lets AI tools query meeting data for insights (e.g., 'compare objections across prospects'). This demonstrates in-product AI-generated insights and suggestions. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of AskFred's insight quality, and more detail on proactive/unprompted suggestion generation beyond query-based responses.
